name: USA Pacific Deterrence Initiative: 9,86 Mrd USD für KI-gestützte ISR und Indo-Pacific Maritime Domain Awareness (FY2025)
name_de: USA Pacific Deterrence Initiative: 9,86 Mrd USD für KI-gestützte ISR und Indo-Pacific Maritime Domain Awareness (FY2025)
name_en: US Pacific Deterrence Initiative: USD 9.86 billion for AI-assisted ISR and Indo-Pacific Maritime Domain Awareness (FY2025)
description: Das US-Verteidigungsministerium identifizierte im FY2025-Budgetantrag rund 9,86 Milliarden US-Dollar Pacific Deterrence Initiative (PDI). Darin: 96 Mio USD für die Navy-ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance) und Special Operations Command Pacific in den Philippinen; 47 Mio USD für die Army, größtenteils für klassifizierte Programme und ein 'Processing, Exploitation, and Dissemination (PED) Reach Center' zur sensorunabhängigen Datenfusion. Das Indo-Pacific Maritime Domain Awareness (IPMDA)-Programm liefert Pazifik-Partnern KI-Auswerte-Werkzeuge zur Schiffs-Identifikation. Pazifik-Inseln werden damit Mitnutzer eines US-KI-Beobachtungsapparats, ohne nationale Auditmechanismen.

description_en: In the FY2025 budget request the US Department of Defense identified roughly USD 9.86 billion as Pacific Deterrence Initiative (PDI). This includes USD 96 million for Navy ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance) and Special Operations Command Pacific in the Philippines; USD 47 million for the Army, largely for classified programmes and a 'Processing, Exploitation, and Dissemination (PED) Reach Center' for sensor-agnostic data fusion. The Indo-Pacific Maritime Domain Awareness (IPMDA) programme delivers AI analytics tools for vessel identification to Pacific partners. Pacific Island states thereby become co-users of a US AI surveillance apparatus without national audit mechanisms.
